column1: # Golden corpus of book release names: what the parser reads and what the automatic choice decides, one tab-separated row per release.
# Requests (BookReleaseCorpusTests): mushoku = the light novel "Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation" by Rifujin na Magonote; waykings = the book
# "The Way of Kings" by Brandon Sanderson; pride = the book "Pride and Prejudice" by Jane Austen. Each asks for English, allows every book format and
# uses the default sizes per volume (e-book 150 MB, illustrated 300 MB, manga 700 MB). "-" is empty; volumes are a single number or a range;
# reason is the last reason of the decision; score is the sum of the points.
# The first eleven rows are the Nyaa answers of 2026-10-29 for "Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation" (the shared series name restored in front).
